summary: A cross-shaped, multi-tiered structure featuring two tall observation towers on opposite wings. The building has a flat roof made of reddish blocks, layered walls of white and yellow blocks, and is enclosed by a simple, spaced-out white block perimeter. A small, detached secondary structure sits in one corner of the courtyard.

shape.overall_form: Cruciform (cross-shaped) main building with two flanking towers and a small outbuilding.
shape.symmetry: Bilateral symmetry along the main axis, broken only by the small detached outbuilding in one quadrant.

materials.name: quartz_block
materials.role: wall banding, roof trim, and perimeter boundary

rebuild_hints: Start by laying out a symmetrical cross (+) footprint for the main building.
Build the walls using alternating horizontal bands of white and yellow blocks to create the tiered look.
Construct the two tall towers at the ends of the left and right wings, using grey blocks for the corner pillars.
Cap the main building and towers with flat roofs using a reddish block, bordered by a rim of white blocks.
Place sea lanterns at the inner and outer corners of the roof intersections for illumination.
Add the small detached structure in the bottom-left quadrant of the courtyard.
Surround the entire complex with a boundary made of single white blocks spaced one block apart.
uncertainties: The exact block types for the yellow walls (could be sandstone, end stone bricks, or yellow concrete) and the red roof (could be bricks, granite, or red nether bricks) are uncertain due to distance.
The interior layout, floor divisions, and contents are completely unknown as there are no visible interior shots.
The specific purpose of the small detached structure is unclear.
